$comment.purpose: One entry per painted asset in public/jungle/. pipeline.py walks this list and runs raw -> key -> upscale -> export for each entry. audit.py reads the 'upscale.factor' to know an asset's REAL source resolution.
$comment.id: stable slug for the asset; names the raw file and the work/ intermediates.
$comment.role: 'mass' = low-frequency background/band read at large screen coverage. 'detail' = oversampled sprite/prop read small on screen. Informational; it does not change the pipeline.
$comment.gen: how the raw was generated. 'size' is the generator's native output (never larger than 1536 on the long edge), 'quality' is the generator's own quality knob, 'prompt' is the verbatim prompt so the raw is reproducible.
$comment.raw: path, relative to tools/gen/, of the generated PNG. Must be painted on a solid ~black backdrop for key.py.
$comment.key: keying thresholds, see key.py. 't_bg': L below this is backdrop. 't_fg': L at/above this is fully opaque. 'soft_px': width of the soft alpha band eroded in from the matte edge.
$comment.upscale: 'factor' multiplies the keyed resolution. 'engine': 'lanczos' (always available) or 'esrgan' (falls back to lanczos when unavailable).
$comment.export: 'out' is the WebP path relative to tools/gen/ (so ../../public/jungle/<name>.webp). 'quality' is the WebP quality 1-100. Add an optional 'width' to cap the exported width.

gen.prompt: A single massive ancient fantasy jungle tree, full figure, isolated on a SOLID PURE BLACK background (#000000) — every background pixel pure black, no vignette, no haze, no stars, no ground plane beyond the roots. Digital painting for a 2.5D parallax game layer, bioluminescent night-jungle style (Avatar-like). Dark moss-covered twisting trunk with broad buttress roots at the base, and two wide umbrella-like canopy tiers (a large upper crown and a smaller lower side crown). IMPORTANT: the canopy reads as SOFT BROAD MASSES of deep-teal foliage with a gentle cyan bioluminescent glow from within — no individual leaves, no tiny flowers, no mushrooms, no hanging vines, no fine tendrils, no small details anywhere. Smooth painterly low-frequency forms, soft simple silhouette. Palette: deep teal and cyan glow on the canopy, dark desaturated green-brown on the trunk. The tree fills the frame top to bottom.

A cluster of small glowing amber-orange jungle flowers with tiny white-hot centers, nestled among a few dark teal palm fronds, painted in a lush bioluminescent night-jungle digital-painting style (fantasy, Avatar-like). The cluster is centered and fills about 70% of the frame. Isolated on a SOLID PURE BLACK background (#000000) — no vignette, no glow haze filling the background, no stars, no ground; every background pixel pure black. Crisp painterly detail, rich saturated color, soft rim light on petals.

A hanging curtain of bioluminescent jungle vines: several thin vines hanging straight down from a dark mossy branch that crosses the very top of the frame, each vine strung with tiny glowing cyan-white bead-like droplets, a few dark small leaves. Lush fantasy night-jungle digital-painting style. Isolated on a SOLID PURE BLACK background (#000000) — no vignette, no glow haze filling the background, every background pixel pure black. Crisp painterly detail.

A single clump of dense jungle-canopy foliage: dark deep-teal leaves with individually painted crisp edges, speckled with small cyan bioluminescent dots and a few glowing leaf tips, like a piece of a giant tree's crown seen at night. Fantasy bioluminescent night-jungle digital-painting style (Avatar-like). The clump is centered, roughly round, filling about 75% of the frame. Isolated on a SOLID PURE BLACK background (#000000) — no vignette, no haze, every background pixel pure black. Crisp painterly detail.

A cluster of glowing blue-cyan shelf mushrooms (bracket fungi) growing on a piece of dark mossy tree bark, some tiny glowing spore dots drifting just above them. Fantasy bioluminescent night-jungle digital-painting style. Cluster centered, filling about 65% of the frame. Isolated on a SOLID PURE BLACK background (#000000) — no vignette, no background haze, every background pixel pure black. Crisp painterly detail.

A bioluminescent epiphyte fern rosette: arching dark-teal fronds radiating from a central mossy core, each frond edged and tipped with a glowing cyan line of light. Fantasy night-jungle digital-painting style (Avatar-like). Rosette centered, filling about 70% of the frame. Isolated on a SOLID PURE BLACK background (#000000) — no vignette, no haze, every background pixel pure black. Crisp painterly detail.

A small patch of dark moss on bark with a scatter of glowing amber-orange bioluminescent seed pods and two or three tiny cyan glow dots, fantasy night-jungle digital-painting style. Patch centered, filling about 60% of the frame. Isolated on a SOLID PURE BLACK background (#000000) — no vignette, no haze, every background pixel pure black. Crisp painterly detail.
